observations: body L1: the kappa of «κάρβας» is printed in the curly form; transcribed κ.
body L2: a short stroke like an accent is printed above the second A of «Schiaparelli»; not transcribed.
body L4: a dot is printed above the u of «Eugenium»; not transcribed.
body L5: a short stroke like an acute accent is printed above the e of «Albatenii»; not transcribed.
body L7: the d of «ad» is printed broken.

body L8-L9 (inscriptions of the Griffini codex): printed as in the codex, «ڡاطاعرڡا», «لوررڡطس» and «ارڡطوس» with the loop of fa or qaf without dots (ڡ); the dots of the ta of «الشتوية» in the left-hand item of the first row are printed displaced; «الصيفيــة» is printed stretched (tatweel).
body L31: «5{sup:*p*} 10» in the II terminum is printed without the minute sign.
notes_left L7: a stray dot is printed in the middle of the column after «Pseudoptolemaei.»; not transcribed.
